Projects

College Magazine

My B.Tech final-year project (2021–22) at Kakinada Institute of Engineering and Technology. Team-9, six students, guided by P. Rama Krishna, HOD of CSE. I also prepared and presented the project deck.

The problem: events, placement links and class notes were scattered across WhatsApp groups, and chats got cleared. College Magazine is one web app where students get college news, class recordings, faculty PDFs and timetables, and an admin login keeps it all up to date.

What makes it work well

  • One reliable place. Events, placement drives, registration links and results stay organised instead of vanishing from chats.
  • No missed classes. Students watch or download recordings, filtered by branch, year, semester and subject.
  • Study offline. Faculty PDFs and recordings can be downloaded.
  • Controlled publishing. Students register and sign in; only the HOD and faculty admin login can upload.
  • Full admin control. Add, edit and delete across posts, timetables, recordings, PDFs and faculty, plus a student feedback module.
  • Designed, then tested. Use case, sequence and activity diagrams first; unit, integration, validation, output and user acceptance testing after.
  • Clear next steps. A student chat feature, and admin rights for class representatives.

Material Collector

A team project I led, with six teammates and a mentor. Engineering students usually hunt across many websites for books, PDFs and video lessons. Material Collector puts them all in one site, organised by branch.

After creating an account and signing in, students open books, follow video links by subject to YouTube lessons, or download PDFs to study offline. The site has home, registration, login, books, videos, PDFs, about and contact pages.
